name: Minagawa Shio
source: Once a volleyball player skilled enough to compete on the world stage, she now serves as a physical education teacher and the advisor to the volleyball club. She possesses a candid, refreshing personality. However, she is fiercely attached to her own methods, and her coaching can only be described as extreme. While she does no harm to students who are poor at sports, she subjects those in whom she sees potential to a spartan regimen, saddling them with excessive physical training quotas.
